data.display_address: Golfville Block A, Golfville, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Step into resort-style living at Golfville Block A, Emaar's sought-after address nestled within the lush green heart of Dubai Hills Estate. This well-appointed 1-bedroom apartment spans 496 sq. ft. offering a smart layout complete with a walk-in closet and a private balcony.

The unit is unfurnished and move-in ready, giving you the freedom to make it your own from day one. Covered parking is included.

Golfville residents enjoy a lifestyle that rivals a five-star retreat, with access to:

Resort-style pool with a sun lounging deck
Fully equipped gym with dedicated yoga zone
Children's pool and play area
Barbecue area and community lawn
Co-working rooms and a library
Indoor and outdoor cinema
On-site convenience store
24/7 security and concierge lobby

About Dubai Hills Estate

Set across a master-planned 2,700-acre community built around an 18-hole championship golf course managed by Troon Golf, Dubai Hills Estate is one of Emaar's most complete and prestigious developments. The building sits footsteps from the golf course and its iconic clubhouse, with direct access to Dubai Hills Park and Dubai Hills Mall — home to over 650 retail and dining outlets.

Dedicated cycling and jogging tracks wind through the community, while top-rated schools, nurseries, and King's College Hospital are all within reach. Al Khail Road keeps you connected to the wider city, with Downtown Dubai roughly 15 minutes away and Dubai Marina around 20 minutes away.
